record.edic_text:
1304 diatribo {dee-at-ree'-bo}

from 1223 and the base of 5147;; v

AV - abide 5, tarry 2, continue 2, be 1; 10

1) to rub between, rub hard
2) to wear away, consume
3) to spend, pass time
